text: 据商务部，2026年1-6月，全国新设立外商投资企业31617家，同比增长5.3%；实际使用外资金额4021.4亿元人民币，同比下降5%。6月当月实际使用外资同比增长15.1%。
text_en: According to the Ministry of Commerce, from January to June 2026, 31,617 new foreign-invested enterprises were established nationwide, up 5.3% year-on-year; actual use of foreign capital was 402.14 billion yuan, down 5% year-on-year. In June alone, actual use of foreign capital rose 15.1% year-on-year.
